releaseNotes: Rename an account straight from Settings, where its balance is shown - no need to go to Payment Methods for it
Add another account, and what it holds today, from the same place
The first-run balance prompt now asks about the accounts you actually have, by name, instead of a fixed Bank and Cash pair
Fixed: the first-run prompt silently discarded what you typed if you had renamed Bank or Cash. Nothing was saved and nothing said so
A balance field left blank is no longer taken as zero - it is left untouched, so a balance restored from your spreadsheet survives
Installs over the top of 3.6.0 or later
